unknown_reasons.not_authorized: The evaluator lacks authorization to run the competitor.
unknown_reasons.not_available: The competitor artifact or service was unavailable.
unknown_reasons.budget_blocked: No signed measurement-budget authorization covers the run.
unknown_reasons.missing_measurements: One or more required case/trial cells have no observation.
unknown_reasons.unsupported_product: The product does not support the measured connector or surface.

access_blockage.rule: An access-blocked competitor cell remains unknown and requires a relative, hash-bound evidence file; the evaluator never fabricates a competitor result.

rule: Unknown cells remain null and reason-coded; this harness never estimates or substitutes competitor results. A comparison is measured only when every case/product/trial cell is observed and the corresponding product is not explicitly unknown.
